scenery @2:look#0.name: safety web
scenery @2:look#0.text:
Escape Pod
This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely automated. The bulkhead leading out is closed.
 
You feel the pod begin to slide down its ejection tube as explosions shake the mother ship.
 
>

scenery @2:examine safety web#1.name: safety web
scenery @2:examine safety web#1.text:
The safety webbing fills most of the pod. It could accomodate from one to, perhaps, twenty people.
 
Through the viewport of the pod you see the Feinstein dwindle as you head away. Bursts of light dot its hull. Suddenly, a huge explosion blows the Feinstein into tiny pieces, sending the escape pod tumbling away! 
 
You are thrown against the bulkhead, bruising a few limbs. The safety webbing might have offered a bit more protection.
 
As the escape pod tumbles away from the former location of the Feinstein, its gyroscopes whine. The pod slowly stops tumbling. Lights on the control panel blink furiously as the autopilot searches for a reasonable destination.
 
>

scenery @2:look#2.name: Patrol uniform
scenery @2:look#2.text:
Escape Pod
This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely automated. The bulkhead leading out is closed.
 
The auxiliary rockets fire briefly, and a nearby planet swings into view through the port. It appears to be almost entirely ocean, with just a few visible islands and an unusually small polar ice cap. A moment later, the system's sun swings into view, and the viewport polarizes into a featureless black rectangle.
 
>

scenery @2:examine patrol uniform#3.name: Patrol uniform
scenery @2:examine patrol uniform#3.text:
It is a standard-issue one-pocket Stellar Patrol uniform, a miracle of modern technology. It will keep its owner warm in cold climates and cool in warm locales. It provides protection against mild radiation, repels all insects, absorbs sweat, promotes healthy skin tone, and on top of everything else, it is super-comfy.
 
The main thrusters fire a long, gentle burst. A monotonic voice issues from the control panel. "Approaching planet...human-habitable."
 
>

scenery @2:look#6.name: chronometer
scenery @2:look#6.text:
Escape Pod
This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely automated. The bulkhead leading out is closed.
 
>

scenery @2:examine chronometer#7.name: chronometer
scenery @2:examine chronometer#7.text:
It is a standard wrist chronometer with a digital display. According to the chronometer, the current time is 5152. The back is engraved with the message "Good luck in the Patrol! Love, Mom and Dad."
 
The pod is buffeted as it enters the planet's atmosphere.
 
>

scenery @2:look#8.name: Patrol-issue self-contained multi-purpose scrub brush
scenery @2:look#8.text:
Escape Pod
This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely automated. The bulkhead leading out is closed.
 
You feel the temperature begin to rise, and the pod's climate control system roars as it labors to compensate.
 
>

scenery @2:examine patrol-issue self-con.name: Patrol-issue self-contained multi-purpose scrub brush
scenery @2:examine patrol-issue self-con.cmd: examine patrol-issue self-contained multi-purpose scrub brush
scenery @2:examine patrol-issue self-con.text:
I see nothing special about the Patrol-issue self-contained multi-purpose scrub brush.
 
The viewport suddenly becomes transparent again, giving you a view of endless ocean below. The lights on the control panel flash madly as the pod's computer searches for a suitable landing site. The thrusters fire long and hard, slowing the pod's descent.
 
>

scenery @33:look#16.name: laser setting dial
scenery @33:look#16.text:
Tool Room
This is apparently a storage room for tools. Exits lead northeast and east.
Sitting on the floor below the lowest shelf is a large glass flask.
A small device, labelled "Akmee Portabul Laazur", is resting on one of the lower shelves.
The laser contains:
  An old battery
On an upper shelf is a metal bar, curved into a U-shape.
There is a pair of wide-nosed pliers here.
 
>

scenery @39:look#18.name: crevice
scenery @39:look#18.text:
Admin Corridor South
This section of hallway seems to have suffered some minor structural damage. The walls are cracked, and a jagged crevice crosses the floor. An opening leads east and the corridor heads north and south.
 
>

scenery @39:examine crevice#19.name: crevice
scenery @39:examine crevice#19.text:
Lying at the bottom of the narrow crack, partly covered by layers of dust, is a shiny steel key!
 
>

scenery @59:look#20.name: ladder
scenery @59:look#20.text:
Admin Corridor
The hallway, in fact the entire building, has been rent apart here, presumably by seismic upheaval. You can see the sky through the severed roof above, and the ground is thick with rubble. To the north is a gaping rift, at least eight meters across and thirty meters deep. A metal ladder spans the rift. A wide doorway, labelled "Sistumz Moniturz," leads west.
 
If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out.
 
>

scenery @59:examine ladder#21.name: ladder
scenery @59:examine ladder#21.text:
It is a heavy-duty ladder built of sturdy aluminum tubing. It is currently extended to its full length of about 8 meters, but could be collapsed to a shorter length for easier carrying.
 
>
